name: Jeeter | Juneberry | 2G Liquid Diamond XL All-In-One Vape
description: Bright, berry forward, and lightly fizzy. Juneberry opens with syrupy dark berry and a crisp citrus pop, giving blueberry energy with a little sparkle. Sweet on the inhale, smooth on the exhale, and finished with a clean blend of berry and soft cherry.
